name: Four Seasons Hotel Shenzhen
positioning: Hotel in the 26-story tower of a multi-use complex in Shenzhen's Futian district, across from the Shenzhen Conference & Exhibition Center
best_for: Travelers attending events at the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Centre
Travelers who want a Shenzhen base for day trips to Hong Kong by high-speed rail

facts.text: The hotel has 266 rooms in total.
The hotel is located in the 26-story tower of a multi-use complex.
The address is 138 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen.
Zhuo Yue Xuan offers classic Cantonese cuisine.
Matsuyi is the hotel's Japanese restaurant.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: Zhuo Yue Xuan has 10 private dining rooms.
The Club Grand Room offers sweeping 180° views of Shenzhen's skyline.
Matsuyi has a six-seat sushi and sashimi counter.
Hong Kong is a 15-minute high-speed rail journey from Futian station to West Kowloon station.

considerations.text: A China visa is required when coming from Hong Kong unless your passport is from an exempt country.
The Executive Club Lounge is complimentary for select suite bookings, with paid access available for other guests.
The hotel is in the heart of the commercial district of Futian.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
